actions.title: backup: set fleet identity
actions.description: Declare (or clear) this destination's position in a multi-drive backup fleet. Writes into the destination's own `manifest.json` so the drive is self-describing — plug it into another machine and it still knows it is drive 2 of 3. Editing by hand is not an option: the manifest is compact single-line JSON with tens of thousands of rows. Pass `fleetSize: 1` (or 0/null) to return the drive to standalone selection. Electron IPC channel 'backup:set-fleet-identity', window.electron.backupSetFleetIdentity() in the renderer (registerBackupHandlers.ts).
notes: Rewrites the backup target's manifest.json (atomic, keeps a .bak).
